title: Mutation of Fano Simplices and Markov type equations
summary: It is well known that there is a bijective correspondence between the set of positive integer solutions to the Markov equation and the set of Fano triangles mutation equivalent to the Fano triangle of $\mathbb{P}^2$. In this paper, we establish a higher dimensional generalization of this correspondence for arbitrary Fano simplices of any dimension. On the polyhedral side, we introduce a distinguished class of facets, called admissible facets, and show that their number is preserved under facet mutation.
